Hide My Email on the device vs zh-Hans listing copy — two different jobs

Teams assume iCloud+ email privacy messaging covers storefront language. iOS account settings and App Store Connect actually separate system relays from product-page copy:

  • Hide My Email on the device — iCloud+ subscribers create random relay addresses under Settings → Apple Account → iCloud → Hide My Email. Messages forward to the user's real inbox; the relay can be deactivated per site or app. During Sign in with Apple, buyers can choose Hide My Email to share a relay instead of their primary address. System iCloud+ behavior — outside AppLocale scope.
  • Relay address management in Mail and Safari — users label, deactivate, or create relays from Mail settings and sign-up sheets. Configuring buyer Mail accounts is user-side setup — AppLocale does not configure Mail for buyers and does not create relay addresses on their behalf.
  • Hide My Email marketing on the product page — description paragraphs, subtitle positioning, keywords, promotional text, and screenshot overlays that tell buyers your app works with Hide My Email, recommends relay addresses on sign-up, or aligns with Sign in with Apple private-email flows. Connect text fields — this page.
  • Pricing and Availability → China — makes the app downloadable on the China storefront. Separate from language rows.
  • App Store tab → Chinese (Simplified) localization — independent row for title, subtitle, keywords, description, promotional text, and screenshot caption lines. Empty or English here means China buyers see English fallback regardless of Hide My Email positioning in the app.

An app that references Hide My Email in onboarding and a localized China listing are both valuable — neither replaces the other. AppLocale covers how you describe relay-email privacy on the store page, not whether relay addresses exist on a buyer's Apple Account.

Hide My Email vs Private Relay, Contact Key Verification, and Advanced Data Protection — disambiguation

Apple groups several iCloud+ and account privacy toggles across Settings. Indie teams conflate them on one product page. AppLocale covers Hide My Email and relay-address marketing on listing metadata — not the other features:

  • Hide My Email (this page) — random relay email addresses for sign-ups and account creation under Settings → Apple Account → iCloud → Hide My Email; also available during Sign in with Apple → Hide My Email. Gallery frames may show relay lists, deactivate toggles, or private-email sign-up sheets. zh-Hans terms: 隐藏电子邮件, 隐藏我的电子邮件, 随机邮件地址, 中继邮箱, 保护真实邮箱, Sign in with Apple 隐藏电子邮件.
  • iCloud Private Relay (different) — encrypted Safari browsing and IP-hiding privacy feature — 专用代理 vocabulary — not email relay addresses. See Private Relay listing when hide-IP Safari browsing is your lead.
  • Contact Key Verification (different) — iMessage identity assurance with public verification codes — 联系人密钥验证 vocabulary — not relay email addresses. See Contact Key Verification listing when iMessage contact-key checks are your lead.
  • Advanced Data Protection for iCloud (different) — optional end-to-end encryption for most iCloud data categories — 高级数据保护 and 端到端加密 vocabulary — not Hide My Email relay lists. See Advanced Data Protection listing when iCloud encryption toggles are your lead.
  • Stolen Device Protection and Lockdown Mode (different) — theft hardening and extreme threat protection under Face ID & Passcode or Privacy & Security — not relay-email privacy unless your English source genuinely markets both.
  • Passwords, AutoFill, iCloud Drive, Mail Privacy Protection as lead (different) — separate Apple features with unrelated buyer vocabulary. Do not keyword-stuff 密码, 自动填充, 云盘, or Mail pixel-blocking terms when English only marketed Hide My Email relay addresses.

Your gallery may show a Hide My Email relay list on one frame and a Sign in with Apple sheet on the next — but listing copy should name each claim accurately per frame. A relay-address badge is not a Private Relay browsing-privacy pitch, not a Contact Key Verification public-code story, and not an Advanced Data Protection encryption toggle unless that is what the screenshot shows.

Hide My Email–specific vocabulary — what translates differently in zh-Hans

Relay-email marketing on App Store pages uses vocabulary general localization guides rarely cover. zh-Hans copy should reflect how Chinese App Store readers evaluate Hide My Email — not a literal paste of US marketing:

隐藏电子邮件 vs 隐藏我的电子邮件

Apple's Chinese system UI uses 隐藏邮件地址 or 隐藏我的电子邮件 for the Hide My Email feature under Apple 账户 → iCloud. Product-page copy may also use 隐藏电子邮件 as a concise headline on screenshot overlays. AppLocale picks the term buyers recognize on each frame — a Settings walkthrough needs Settings-aligned phrasing; a benefit headline may use 隐藏电子邮件 when accurate to your English source.

随机邮件地址 and 中继邮箱 (random relay addresses)

US pages use "Random relay address", "Unique forwarding address", or "Relay email alias." China storefront copy uses 随机邮件地址 or 中继邮箱 when describing the alias Apple generates — not Private Relay 专用代理 vocabulary and not third-party disposable-mailbox product claims unless your app genuinely sells those.

保护真实邮箱 (keep your real address private)

Hide My Email value props center on not exposing the primary inbox to every website. zh-Hans marketing uses 保护真实邮箱, 不暴露真实邮箱, or 注册时不透露真实邮箱 on frames that explain sign-up privacy — not Safari 隐藏 IP 地址 unless your English source showed Private Relay instead.

Sign in with Apple 隐藏电子邮件

During Sign in with Apple, buyers can choose Hide My Email instead of sharing their Apple ID email. Screenshot captions that walk through that sheet should use Sign in with Apple 隐藏电子邮件 or 通过 Apple 登录时隐藏邮件 when the frame depicts the relay option — distinct from generic 通过 Apple 登录 login-speed copy on our Sign in with Apple guide when Hide My Email is not the hero claim.

Settings path: Apple Account → iCloud → Hide My Email

Relay management lives under Settings → Apple Account (Apple ID) → iCloud → Hide My Email on Chinese iPhones and Macs. Screenshot captions that walk buyers to relay lists should use the Chinese settings path buyers see on device — not iCloud → Private Relay like Safari IP hiding, and not Contact Key Verification under Apple Account.

Subtitle and keyword packing

The 30-character subtitle and 100-character keyword field need email-privacy search terms Chinese buyers type — see Simplified Chinese keywords & subtitle for field mechanics. Terms like 隐藏电子邮件, 随机邮件地址, and 中继邮箱 each signal different intent from Private Relay, Contact Key Verification, or Passwords keywords.

Caption lines vs burned-in badges

Marketing screenshot overlays you control — "Hide My Email" headlines on gallery frames showing relay lists or Sign in with Apple sheets — are separate caption fields or burned-in PNG text. AppLocale FAQ

What is Apple Hide My Email?

Hide My Email is under Settings → Apple Account → iCloud → Hide My Email. iCloud+ subscribers create random relay addresses — 随机邮件地址 — that forward to a real inbox without exposing it on every sign-up. Sign in with Apple flows can offer Hide My Email as a private-email option. Marketing that awareness on your en-US page does not auto-fill zh-Hans Connect fields.

Does mentioning Hide My Email auto-translate my China listing?

No. Hide My Email is a system iCloud+ feature on the buyer's Apple Account — it does not create or fill a Simplified Chinese localization row. Empty or English zh-Hans fields mean China buyers see en-US fallback on the product page.

How is Hide My Email different from iCloud Private Relay?

Hide My Email hides the real email address with relay aliases — 隐藏电子邮件, 随机邮件地址, 中继邮箱. Private Relay hides IP addresses while browsing Safari — 专用代理, 隐藏 IP 地址. Email relays and Safari IP masking are separate features with different Settings paths. See our Private Relay listing guide only when Safari browsing privacy is your lead claim.

How is this different from Contact Key Verification or Advanced Data Protection?

Hide My Email listing copy markets relay email addresses for sign-ups. Contact Key Verification markets iMessage identity assurance — 联系人密钥验证. Advanced Data Protection markets iCloud end-to-end encryption — 高级数据保护. Each is a separate Apple feature — do not reuse boilerplate across them.

How is this different from the Sign in with Apple listing guide?

Our Sign in with Apple guide covers login-speed and Continue with Apple marketing when Hide My Email is secondary. This page covers Hide My Email, relay addresses, and 保护真实邮箱 as the lead claim — including Sign in with Apple 隐藏电子邮件 when relay privacy is what your gallery shows.
